title: viewport.captureDeterministic request params
description: Accept a deterministic capture request; the engine reports the outcome separately in viewport.captureCompleted and writes the image to a file.

captureDir.description: Absolute UTF-8 path of the existing capture directory created by the editor.

outputName.description: PNG base name without extension or path separators.

settleFrames.description: Number of fixed steps in the new capture epoch before drawing.
